public.text: CRVS is grouped with cross-sector infrastructure, but vital-event registration has direct and substantial health-sector participation. The boundary between health-generated birth or death notifications and authoritative civil registration is not explained.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that health systems may generate and exchange notifications or medical cause-of-death information, while the legally authoritative civil registration function remains with the designated civil authority.
